name: Release
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "**"
    tags-ignore:
      - "**"
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/release.yml
      - package/**/*
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: "Git tag for the release"
        required: true
        type: string
env:
  PKG_APPLE_DEVELOPER_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.PKG_APPLE_DEVELOPER_TEAM_ID }}

    shell: bash -xeu
